description: Publication-ready scientific figures from one command — 38 chart types (bar, slope, volcano, ridgeline, dumbbell, grouped bar, scatter, heatmap, forest plot (incl. Cox), KM survival curve with risk table, competing-risk cumulative incidence (Aalen-Johansen), ROC, calibration curve, decision curve (DCA), nomogram, RCS spline, subgroup forest, violin, box, composite panels, PRISMA 2020 flow, funnel, Galbraith radial, Bland-Altman, PCA, venn 2-4 sets, upset set intersections (5+ sets), oncology waterfall (RECIST), raincloud, swimmer, clustered heatmap, dual-axis), 9 themes (colorblind-safe Okabe-Ito, NEJM/Lancet/Science), 9 journal presets, YAML pipeline, TIFF/PNG/PDF, Python API, --wizard, render watchdog, overlap gate, 600dpi. 100% local, data never leaves the machine. Use for — paper/submission figures, data files to publication charts, batch re-rendering. Skip when — text polishing, translation or rewriting (writing tools); business dashboards or slide/poster decoration; diagrams with no data behind them.
